reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with Discount Pools when Tony replaced our sand filter. From start to finish, he was professional, quick to respond, and incredibly knowledgeable. He always took the time to offer options when available, which we really appreciated. It’s clear he’s trustworthy and takes pride in his work — everything was done efficiently, thoroughly, and he left the area spotless.  We wouldn’t hesitate to call him again and highly recommend him to anyone needing pool work done right

Discount Pool Repair & Renovation did an outstanding job fixing my pool pump gasket today! The team was professional, prompt, and highly skilled. They quickly diagnosed the issue and had it repaired in no time, ensuring my pool was back up and running perfectly. Their service was top-notch, and I highly recommend them to anyone in Arlington, TX, needing reliable pool repairs. Thank you for the great work!

I had a very positive experience with my pool replastering job. What started out as what we had hoped to be a small project turned into a much larger one. It turns out that the previous owners had unsatisfactory work done on this pool. They had multiple layers of plaster put on and that needed to be removed and redone properly. I don't usually do reviews, but Tony deserves to be recognized. He is very responsive and knowledgeable. He advised me on what was needed and took time to explain everything. I will definitely be using his services in the future.

Discount Pool has been my go to for all pool repairs, maintenance and more!  They resurfaced our pool recently and it turned out great.  The team was very professional, the work was done timely and cleaned up after they were finished!  They have also helped me w our pool sweep and pump motor!  You won’t be disappointed.

Tony with Discount Pools Repairs and Renovations was very knowledgeable, professional, but more importantly friendly. The work was completed on time and all questions answered patiently. We had all tile in the pool and hot tub replaced as well as complete resurfacing on both. They were less expensive than the other 2 quotes, yet we received excellent work by his crew. We had one issue that Tony came out to inspect and he had it fixed THAT DAY! I do highly recommend this company with any of your

Tony has done work on my pool 3 different times and I have nothing but gratitude for him. His prices are great, his work is impeccable and above all his customer service is above the 5 stars allowed here

This pool service is great. They are very down to earth and honest. The work is exceptional and they are very neat and tidy on the clean up.  They gave a cost that was affordable and just did a great job. I'm keeping them on my list! I will recommend them to all my friends.
Tony is very helpful and knowledgeable about pools. He is very personable but professional at the same time. Definitely would Recommend him for anyone who needs a pool guy in the Arlington area.
Excellent service. Tony is very knowledgeable, courteous, and responsive. Not easy to find reliable assistance in pool repairs. So save this number, you will be happy you did.

Extremely professional, honest, and trustworthy. Our experiences with past companies have left us with a bitter feeling on quality and overall trust. Tony and his team has changed our views. This company is valued in my household and would absolutely recommend them to anyone needing to be educated or needing immediate assistance with their pool needs. I had a leak in my pool and was losing water rapidly. I found  Tony on the internet and was so glad I called. He knew exactly how to repair the issue. Tony and the crew did exactly what they told me they would do. Always on time and very professional. I think I have a new pool company for life.
Tony came out to fix my pool pump and had it fixed in 15 minutes!  He was very  knowledgeable and also gave me an estimate for plaster for next year. I would definitely recommend this company.

An amazing experience. My husband, Nick, and I really appreciate Tony's ability to quickly assess what was wrong with our pool. Tony completed the repairs professionally and provided additional pool maintenance education. We learned more from Tony than we have ever known about our pool. I would highly recommend Tony to complete your pool repairs. He was very efficient and cleaned up afterwards which is always a plus with us!

Tony has been so kind and patient to explain everything to a new pool caretaker (me). He recommended and installed a new filter system, which is a lot easier maintenance and cleaning for me than the old DE one that wasn’t working properly. Within 2 days, my pool was clearer than it had been in months. He also unclogged a pipe to a skimmer that has never worked! I’m so grateful for his help! 10/10 Would 100% recommend!

Tony was able to get me the last propane heater in the area to replace the dated one I had. The price was good, the customer service was great and the install was fast. He also took the time to show me how to set my valve handles so I could use my spa while the heater was on. I would definitely recommend this company to anyone looking to repair their pools.

This company is great, I highly recommend them for any of your pool needs! Tony is great to work with, very responsive, and professional. He doesn’t waste your time or your money, and is very knowledgeable and willing to go above and beyond to make the customer happy (which is hard to find nowadays).
Tony is absolutely the best!  Great prices and knowledge. Tony replaced my filter with a new Pentair and the turn-key price was the best. You can count on him for all your pool and spa needs.

Tony worked hard to get my pool fixed on a tight deadline, even with the difficulties presented by the Feb 2021 winter storms. Tony replaced my pool plumbing damaged by the freeze/blackout and was responsive and professional. Prices were better and scheduling faster than the other pool plumbers that quoted me. Definitely recommend.

Quick service. Thorough. Excellent workmanship under hot August heat extreme conditions. Fair pricing. Friendly.  Was recommended on Arlington Texas Talks FB page. We also highly recommend based on recent experience.

Tony was great!  He communicates extremely well and responds quick.  He didn't waste any of my time or money.  He was upfront about my repair and wanted to save me as much money as possible.  I will be using Tony for all of my future pool repairs.

Tony was very professional and explained everything that needed to be done in detail. I had a pool that had not been opened in 3 years. He drained cleaned, installed a new pump and replastered my pool. My pool looks like new! He worked within my budget and gave me options on equipment to keep cost down.

Guy was very responsive and nice. Did a service call for me and determined I needed a new filter , unfortunately I had to go with a contractor through my home warranty american home shield but he was very knowledgeable and did not charge me for his assessment had it not been for my home warranty I would have had him replace my filter he was able to offer the service fast within a day also

Responded quickly and scheduled repair for next business day. Was 9% more than competitive bid but felt more confident with Tony. Called to let us know that part was out of stock and would be delayed 1 day. Made repair and answered all my questions until pool was fully back in order.

Quick and convenient.  Everything via text.  Quickly replaced our booster pump.  A couple years later, he repaired my main pump.  Work hard to get to me despite full schedule and bad weather. Quickly becoming my go-to guy.

I’ve been a pool owner for 15 years and have dealt with a few companies. Discount is by far the best with quality, service and products. Since working with DPR it’s easier to maintain and enjoy my pool with my family.

Yours Truly,
A very satisfied customer.

Called to get an estimate for some repairs on a pool with a home we were thinking to buy. He was so professional and knowledgeable that my realtor asked him for a few of his cards so she could refer other clients to him. We ended up buying the house and hired him for the repairs. Couldn't be happier!!!
